facts.fact: NOSi's strategic plan lists the local area networks of municipal councils, beside those of ministries, schools and hospitals, among the networks served by basic access to the state's private network (RTPE), whose access and maintenance services it proposes to open to private providers; it gives no count of councils (no date given; plan dated March 2020).

NOSi, the state's technology enterprise, says it remains responsible for the RTPE and its core network and for secure communication across the state administration, central and local, while proposing to sell the physical wide-area component (no date given; plan dated March 2020).

NOSi's strategic action plan for 2019-2022 budgets ECV 25,000,000 for the RTPE within ECV 65,000,000 for basic digital-government infrastructure, and its RTPE measure names municipal councils' local networks among those to be served (plan dated March 2020).
NOSi's plan says the funds for its restructuring group of projects, which holds the RTPE's ECV 25,000,000, are secured under the World Bank's Cabo Verde Digital financing (plan dated March 2020).
